audit_basis: User-supplied ZIP bytes; no external authorization or brand-standard assertions.

findings.finding: The supplied aiwars-logomark.svg contains the full AI Wars wordmark, with the same viewBox and path geometry as aiwars-logo.svg. Circle/square variants add a square viewport around that same wordmark; they are not an isolated icon.
findings.action: Use this exact wordmark with adequate light space. Do not invent an A, slash, or compact symbol as the official logomark.

findings.finding: The full Foundation logo is approximately 1.59:1 and includes the organization name below the architectural symbol; the supplied logomark omits that wording but retains a 1.59:1 artboard.
findings.action: Respect aspect ratio and allow greater header height; do not squeeze it into the proportions of the other horizontal wordmarks.

findings.finding: Source -circle and -square filenames refer to viewport sizing and spacing. They do not guarantee an added circular/square background or circle-safe crop.
findings.action: Place exact source artwork within a padded avatar canvas and evaluate circular crop separately; retain full source viewBox.

findings.finding: The supplied verticalfoundation-logo-dark.svg is byte-identical to verticalfoundation-logo.svg. The name does not indicate a white-on-dark lockup.
findings.action: Use the separately supplied logo-white variant on dark backgrounds or retain the primary logo on a light field.

findings.finding: White SVG variants can retain unused gradient definitions even when visible fills are white. Color token inventories include defined but unused colors.
findings.action: Preserve the supplied files intact and assess visible rendered output; do not infer usage rules from unused definitions.

findings.finding: The supplied circular brand symbol consists of six paths with magenta-to-cyan radial gradients and transparent negative-space separators.
findings.action: Embed intact source SVG or an exact supplied raster, preserving the six-path geometry. Never draw a replacement circle or fill its negative spaces.

findings.finding: Files are verified against the user-supplied archives. The audit does not establish copyright ownership, trademark permissions, or whether an archive is a brand owner’s latest master.
findings.action: Describe status as source-matched artwork and derivative layout, without claiming owner approval.

aiwars.note: All tokens come from primary supplied SVG; hex values are rounded sRGB representations. Supporting layout colors are not source-defined official brand colors.
